listing.name: Rock Band 3 — rb3pc (dietslack)
listing.summary: This Linux-focused work has known issues. Completion and instrument support are unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Rock Band 3 Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Deluxe additionally needs compatible mod/executable; exact revisions unknown.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use Linux-oriented source build from own Rock Band3 files; Windows builds have not been attempted.

warnings: This Linux-focused work has known issues. Completion and instrument support are unknown.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
